test_get_single_prediction_on_task: test retrieving a single ML prediction on a labeling task via the /api/projects/{id}/next endpoint
test_get_multiple_predictions_on_task: test retrieving multiple ML predictions on a labeling task via the /api/projects/{id}/next endpoint
make_project: create a label studio project with a label config and optional ML backend for testing
make_task: create a labeling task with data payload and associate it with a project for testing
ml_backend_registration: register an ML backend by posting to /api/ml/ with project id, title, and url for testing
